resources.string: Each lecture is a scrollable English classroom board. Tap listen: Urdish TTS explains while the board scrolls with the reading. The voice does not re-read the board.
Scrollable English board دیکھو — Listen سے Urdish explanation سنتے ہوئے board ساتھ scroll ہوتا ہے۔
Open a chapter, then a lecture. Scroll the English board; tap listen for Urdish.
Install Google Urdu TTS if the Urdish lecture voice does not start
